user.title: Remote Print
user.description: IPP address of the printer (AirPrint / IPP Everywhere). Usually ipp://PRINTER-IP/ipp/print; just the IP also works.

error.cannot_connect: The printer does not answer at this address. Is it on? Try ipp://IP/ipp/print, ipps://IP/ipp/print or ipp://IP/ipp.
error.no_driverless: The printer answers but accepts neither PDF, URF nor JPEG: it is not AirPrint / IPP Everywhere.

stampa.name: Print
stampa.description: Prints a file, a URL or a text on the home printer.

file.name: File
file.description: Path of a file inside Home Assistant (must be in allowlist_external_dirs), e.g. /config/www/doc.pdf.

url.name: URL
url.description: Address of a file to download and print.

nome.name: Name
nome.description: Name shown in the list of prints.

adatta.name: Fit to page
adatta.description: Shrink the page into the printable area.

bianco_nero.name: Black and white
bianco_nero.description: Print in grayscale (default from the options).
